lines.text: Emma's fall day hike should have taken three hours.
She packed water and her phone.
Then a wrong turn added two more, the sun dropped and the wind picked up.
Carry the Ten Essentials every time:
navigation, a headlamp, sun protection, first aid, a knife, fire starter, an emergency shelter, and extra food, water and clothes.
Now when Emma takes a wrong turn, it's just a longer day.
Save this before your next hike.
